_comment_discordAppId: Create your own app at https://discord.com/developers/applications, copy its Application ID below. Leave as "0" to keep Discord RPC off regardless of the Settings toggle.
_comment_updateCheckUrl: Optional. A raw-text URL (e.g. a raw GitHub file) containing just your build's version string. Leave blank to skip update checks entirely.
_comment_issueTrackerUrl: Optional. Shown in crash logs / the outdated-version popup. Leave blank to omit.
